Automatic playback depends on an MP4 file corresponding to the registered title (RNF-58, RF-36).
Source movie filename must follow the environment-configured pattern for automatic loading (RNF-59).
Uploading the video file and registering the movie are related but independent steps (RNF-57).
Playback availability depends on both registration and existence of the physical file (RNF-62).
Catalog is displayed in pages of up to 12 movies (RNF-40).
Session remains identified until logout or local data clearing (RNF-47).
